intent: Update the Valoir website for the current Rizz release, repair audited UI defects, and establish the Valoir Shiploop gate.
acceptance_criteria: Website copy reflects source-backed current Rizz capabilities.
Responsive, reduced-motion, keyboard, and progressive-enhancement UI tests pass.
Shiploop derives scope from Git and rejects stale or forged exact-SHA evidence.
Runtime review and certificate evidence remain outside the reviewed Git tree.
A trusted publisher refuses any checked-out or remote PR-head SHA mismatch.
